message.reasoning: We need to answer based on policy excerpts. The question: "After a resolved incident, can I get a written summary of what happened and whether any of our data was affected?" The policy says: Every resolved incident gets a written summary once investigation complete, describing what happened, affected window, and whether any data was affected. Also summaries note if no data was affected. So answer: Yes, each resolved incident gets a written summary on the status page, includes details and data impact. Provide brief answer. Use post_reply.
